text:
Support Bot: Escalation created by support@acme: customer (Acme Global) reporting invoice/payment failures across entities. Primary issues: (1) They need invoices in local currency for EU entity (Acme GmbH) with PO number. (2) Card declined during retry, gateway returns `insufficient_funds`. (3) FX rounding causing small discrepancies between USD-hosted invoice and EUR local invoice causing AP rejection. Ticket: INC-8249.

Maya Patel: cc @Tom Nguyen @Finance Ops — can someone pull the invoices and payment attempt logs? customer is blocked on month-end. :alarm_clock:

Tom Nguyen: pulling INV-2026-54321 and INV-2026-54320 now. quick notes: INV-54321 billed on Hosted (USD) to Acme Global (entity_id: ent-111), fee = $12,345.67. They asked for EUR invoice to be issued under Acme GmbH (ent-222) and include PO `PO-ACME-0099`.

Eli Rosen: Customer says AP system rejects EUR invoice because totals differ by €0.01 due to FX rounding. They attached screenshot of their AP rejection. they provided their local tax ID and company name.

Rajiv Menon: what gateway error did the retry return? I see a `card_decline` on attempt 3 with reason `insufficient_funds`. token ends with 4242 (customer said backup card was used).

Anna Schmidt: customer insists invoice must be in EUR with local VAT broken out and PO on the header. Our current flow issues local invoices only when the billing entity matches the subscription. This customer has multi-entity seat usage (hosted usage consolidated). Need a manual reissue under ent-222.

Maya Patel: steps I'm going to take: 1) Verify mapping ent-111 -> ent-222 for invoicing eligibility. 2) Reissue invoice in EUR with PO on header and VAT lines. 3) Retry charge with their alternate payment method (they provided auth). tagging @Finance Ops for reissue permission.

Tom Nguyen: quick log dump for the currency conversion path (sanitized):
```
2026-07-14T09:12:01Z convert currencies: USD 12,345.67 -> EUR 11,234.56 (rate used: 1 USD = 0.9090 EUR)
2026-07-14T09:12:01Z rounding: result raw = 11234.5673 -> rounded invoice_amount = 11234.57
2026-07-14T09:12:02Z ledger write: host_invoice 12345 USD, local_invoice 11234.57 EUR, rounding_adjustment = -0.01 EUR
```

Tom Nguyen: ledger shows a -0.01 EUR rounding_adjustment. Customer AP expects line totals to match visible total (some AP software doesn't like separate rounding adjustments).

Maya Patel: can we absorb the rounding diff for this reissue? we'd need approval from Finance Ops to apply a one-time rounding credit so totals match exactly.

Finance Ops: @Maya Patel ok to apply one-time rounding credit up to €0.05 for customer goodwill. Please document in the invoice notes: "Rounding credit applied per Acme request to match AP system requirements. Ref INC-8249."

Eli Rosen: Customer also requested PO number on both header and line level. can we add `PO-ACME-0099` to the invoice and metadata?

Anna Schmidt: yes, our reissue flow can add `po_number` field and annotate metadata. Tom, make sure tax/VAT ID for ent-222 is included and VAT lines are explicit.

Tom Nguyen: noted. Also found a config edge case: if subscription owner is in ent-111 but billing_contact is in ent-222, our automatic local-invoice generator doesn't trigger. I'll open a runtime tweak PR to consider billing_contact entity for localization. filed: gitlab#4567.

Maya Patel: reissue plan: generate new invoice INV-2026-54321-R1 in EUR under ent-222, include `PO-ACME-0099`, break out VAT, and apply rounding credit -0.01 so line totals match AP screenshot. Also include audit note. Then trigger manual charge via authorized payment token on file.

Support Bot: Customer provided payment auth token `auth_***_rty` for manual retry.

Rajiv Menon: manual retry attempt succeeded after switching to their provided token. Gateway returned `authorized` and settlement initiated. I'll monitor for settlement.

Eli Rosen: customer confirmed AP accepted the reissued invoice and processed payment flow on their side. They asked for confirmation of settlement and a PDF copy of the reissued invoice with PO and tax info.

Finance Ops: PDF generated and emailed to billing@acme with subject "Reissued Invoice INV-2026-54321-R1 (EUR) — PO-ACME-0099". Settlement expected in 3 business days. Logged waiver/rounding credit in ledger notes.

Tom Nguyen: follow-up action: PR gitlab#4567 to consider billing_contact entity for local invoices opened, assigned to eng-billing. Also add a unit test for conversion rounding behavior.

Maya Patel: closing loop with customer now. leaving this thread open until settlement clears. :white_check_mark:

Finance Ops: marking as resolved in CRM but leaving internal ticket open for 72h to verify settlement.

Maya Patel: Thanks team — good cross-functional response.

Eli Rosen: customer said: "Thanks for the quick turnaround — AP team approved once the PO and rounding note were added." :thumbsup:
